**What would you like WebWordStar to do?**

Describe the feature. If it existed in real WordStar, name the command (e.g. `^Q F`
find) and the version you remember it from — faithfulness to the original is a design
goal.

**Why is it useful?**

The problem it solves or the workflow it enables.

**Alternatives**

Anything you do today to work around it.
